description: A heavy feudal focused build to gain experience for Jeanne. You want her to hit lvl 3 for Holy Wrath to do effective dmg.
name: Simple Jeanne D'arc Feudal Aggression
author: Valdemar1902

notes: All @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to food, @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.png@ builds @building_economy/house.png@ + @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ and gathers @resource/resource_gold.png@

when @resource/resource_gold.webp@-vein is 3900/4000 drop off all @resource/resource_food.png@/@resource/resource_gold.png@ and build @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.png@ with@unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.png@+1 @unit_worker/villager.png@
<- Remacro according to tab. @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ until 5 then @resource/rally.png@ back to @resource/resource_food.png@

<- Remacro according to tab. Queue 1 @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@. @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.png@ builds @building_military/archery-range.png@ then levels up with @ability_jeanne/ability-path-of-the-warrior-1.png@. @resource/rally.png@ @resource/resource_food.png@
Queue 1 @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@. Keep queueing these until win and get eco upgrades after.
@ability_jeanne/ability-path-of-the-warrior-1.webp@ -> @resource/boar.png@(x2) then fight enemy to gain exp.

Tip: When pushing with a timing attack in feudal, make sure Jeanne is lvl 3 for @ability_jeanne/ability-holy-wrath-1.png@to do effective dmg. Jeanne will then have a very high value as a unit, and she can carry against masses of units effectively 3 shotting (with galvanize) enemy units.

description:
This Build Order is meant to level up Jeanne d’Arc fast and fight in Feudal Age with a level 3 (even 4) Jeanne and a powerful army.
Explore the map with your scout and the beginning of the match and find the boars because you will need to hunt them with Jeanne d’Arc to gain EXP.
This Build Order was created by Beastyqt
name: Beastyqt’s Jeanne d’Arc Fast Feudal Level 3 Hero
author: RMSeba13

notes: Send @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.webp@ to build a @building_economy/house.png@and then send her to @resource/sheep.png@

Send the next @unit_worker/villager.webp@to build a @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ and then to @resource/resource_gold.png@. Send the next 3 @unit_worker/villager.png@to @resource/resource_gold.png@as well
Send @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.webp@ to build @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.png@ to age up to @age/age_2.png@
Send a @unit_worker/villager.webp@from @resource/sheep.png@ to build a @building_economy/mill.png@ and then to @resource/berrybush.png@
Build a @building_economy/house.webp@ and a @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ with a @unit_worker/villager.png@ from @resource/resource_wood.png@ when you have enough resources

When @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.webp@ is at 60 - 70 %, send a @unit_worker/villager.png@from @resource/sheep.png@to help @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.png@ to build @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.png@ and then back to @resource/sheep.png@
Immediately start queuing @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ permanently and research @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ and @technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@

Level up @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.webp@ to @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-woman-at-arms-2.webp@ with @ability_jeanne/ability-path-of-the-warrior-1.webp@ when she has enough EXP and immediately send her to hunt @resource/boar.webp@

Depending on your enemy’s army or Military Buildings, build an @building_military/archery-range.webp@ or @building_military/barracks.webp@ with a @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and immediately start queuing @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ or @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ permanently
Build a @building_economy/house.webp@ with the villager who just built @building_military/archery-range.webp@ or @building_military/barracks.webp@

Go fight the enemy with @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-woman-at-arms-2.webp@, @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@/@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@. DO NOT LET @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-woman-at-arms-2.webp@ DIE. If she dies, immediately bring her back in your @building_economy/town-center.webp@

Research @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@, @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@, @technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.webp@ and @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ depending on your enemy’s army composition and your own resources

From now on, the match depends on the enemy’s response and your plans. Make your choices according to that. Keep building Military Buildings to keep pressure on your enemy, or go for a second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ to try to boom and age up to @age/age_3.webp@. Level up @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-woman-at-arms-2.webp@ to @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-knight-3.webp@depending on your enemy’s army composition (@ability_jeanne/ability-champion-companions-1.webp@ if your opponent is going @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ - @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@, or@ability_jeanne/ability-rider-companions-1.webp@ if your opponent is going @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@)

description: JD Deer Opener Into Double Stable Aggro
name: (2026) JD Aggression
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Start 6 on @resource/sheep.webp@ and look for the 1st @resource/deer.webp@pack around your base (there are two, one will be immediately outside tc vision range)
Once @resource/deer.webp@is found, take 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ and gather 50 wood and @building_economy/house.webp@
Pull 4 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ when @building_economy/mill.webp@ is finished
Take rest of @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and go to wood.
Once 8 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ rally then to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 8 and then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@

description: Early Knight build order *Credit to OneofNine
name: Jean D'arc - Feudal Aggression
author: Dirtnasty

notes: Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ when you can to protect Knights from spears
perma fight (try not to lose knights)
All @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to food, @unit_jeanne/jeanne-darc-peasant-1.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ + @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ and gathers @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Rally 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ build 1 @building_economy/house.webp@ on the way
When 10 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ next @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @building_economy/mill.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@
Get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@. Add worker from food to @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.png@ at 60-70%.
Add one to gold. Rally to wood until 12. Then to food.
Go harrass and fight. Get dat xp!
